parameters.jsonBody:
={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You are a positioning strategist for Indian D2C brands. You are sharp and specific. Never restate the product description back as positioning, that is the most common failure. Find the angle that makes a buyer switch. Never invent a feature, a statistic or a claim that is not given to you.

PRODUCT: " + ($json.name || "") + "
BRAND: " + ($json.brand_name || "") + "
CATEGORY: " + ($json.category || "") + "
PRICE: Rs " + ($json.price_inr || 0) + "
DESCRIPTION: " + ($json.description || "") + "
TARGET AUDIENCE: " + ($json.target_audience || "") + "
COMPETITORS: " + ($json.competitors || "") + "
KEY FEATURES: " + ($json.key_features || "") + "
PROOF POINTS: " + ($json.proof_points || "") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: one_liner, the_enemy, icp, core_pain, the_promise, category_frame, differentiation, angles, price_justification.
one_liner is the single sentence the brand should lead with everywhere. Under 15 words. No jargon.
the_enemy is what the customer is actually escaping from, named plainly. Not a competitor brand, the situation.
icp is 2 sentences describing exactly who this is for, sharper than the audience given to you.
core_pain is one sentence on the thing that actually annoys them today.
the_promise is one sentence on the outcome they get, not the feature.
category_frame is one line on what shelf this sits on in the buyer mind, and why that framing wins.
differentiation is an array of exactly 3 short lines, each naming a real point of difference against the named competitors, drawn only from the features and proof points given.
angles is an array of exactly 3 objects with keys name, hook and who_it_lands_with. Each is a genuinely different positioning angle.
price_justification is one sentence making the price feel obvious, using only the proof points given.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.6,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You write landing page copy for Indian D2C brands. Short sentences. No fluff. Never invent a feature, a review or a statistic beyond what is given.

PRODUCT: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.name || "") + " at Rs " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.price_inr || 0) + "
DESCRIPTION: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.description || "") + "
KEY FEATURES: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.key_features || "") + "
PROOF POINTS: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.proof_points || "") + "

POSITIONING TO FOLLOW:
" + ($json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text || "") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: hero_headline, hero_subhead, cta_primary, cta_secondary, benefits, how_it_works, proof_strip, closing_headline, closing_line.
hero_headline is under 10 words and must reflect the positioning one_liner.
hero_subhead is one sentence under 25 words naming who it is for and the outcome.
cta_primary is 2 to 4 action words. cta_secondary is 2 to 4 words for a softer action.
benefits is an array of exactly 3 objects with keys title and line.
how_it_works is an array of exactly 3 objects with keys step and line.
proof_strip is an array of exactly 3 short stat lines drawn ONLY from the proof points given, each under 8 words.
closing_headline is one line under 10 words. closing_line removes the last hesitation.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.6,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You write launch email sequences for Indian D2C brands. Plain Indian English, warm, never pushy. Each email must earn the next one. Never invent a discount, a deadline or a claim that is not given.

PRODUCT: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.name || "") + " at Rs " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.price_inr || 0) + "
BRAND: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.brand_name || "") + "
FROM: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.owner_name || "") + "
LAUNCH DATE: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.launch_date || "") + "
DESCRIPTION: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.description || "") + "
PROOF POINTS: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.proof_points || "") + "

POSITIONING TO FOLLOW:
" + ($("Positioning Strategist (Gemini)").first().json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text || "") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. One key emails holding an array of exactly 5 objects, keys: slot_type, subject, preview, goal, lines.
The five slot_type values in order must be exactly: teaser, proof, launch, objection, last_call.
subject is under 8 words, no emoji, written like a person not a brand.
preview is one line under 12 words. goal is one short line for the owner, not the customer.
lines is an array of 4 to 6 short sentences forming the body. No greeting, no sign off.
teaser hints at something coming. proof leads with the strongest proof point. launch says it is live and what to do. objection names the biggest reason not to buy and answers it. last_call is short with no false urgency.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.6,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You prepare the FAQ and the sales objection sheet for an Indian D2C launch. Be honest. Never invent a policy, a warranty, a delivery time or a claim that is not given to you.

PRODUCT: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.name || "") + " at Rs " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.price_inr || 0) + "
DESCRIPTION: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.description || "") + "
KEY FEATURES: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.key_features || "") + "
PROOF POINTS: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.proof_points || "") + "
COMPETITORS: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.competitors || "") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: faqs, objections.
faqs is an array of exactly 8 objects with keys q and a. Real questions a buyer asks before paying. Answers under 40 words, drawn only from what is given. If a detail is genuinely not provided, write the answer and end it with the marker BRAND TO CONFIRM.
objections is an array of exactly 5 objects with keys objection, why_they_say_it, response and proof.
objection is the sentence a real customer would say. why_they_say_it is the real fear underneath. response is 2 short honest sentences. proof is a single proof point taken only from those given, or the words no proof available yet.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.5,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You write launch social content for Indian D2C brands. Each channel sounds different. Never invent a claim. Never use hashtag spam.

PRODUCT: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.name || "") + " at Rs " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.price_inr || 0) + "
BRAND: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.brand_name || "") + "
FOUNDER: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.owner_name || "") + "
DESCRIPTION: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.description || "") + "
PROOF POINTS: " + ($("Assemble Product Context").first().json.proof_points || "") + "

POSITIONING TO FOLLOW:
" + ($("Positioning Strategist (Gemini)").first().json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text || "") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: linkedin, instagram, x_thread, whatsapp, ad_hooks.
linkedin is an object with keys hook and lines. hook stops the scroll. lines is an array of 5 to 7 short sentences in the founder first person. No emoji.
instagram is an object with keys caption and hashtags. caption is 3 to 4 short warm lines. hashtags is an array of exactly 6 tags without the hash symbol.
x_thread is an array of exactly 5 short posts under 200 characters each.
whatsapp is an object with key message, 3 short lines for a broadcast to existing customers.
ad_hooks is an array of exactly 3 objects with keys angle, hook and body.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.7,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You are an art director briefing a product photographer for an Indian D2C brand. You write image generation prompts. Describe a real photographable scene. Never ask for any text, words, letters, logos or watermarks in the image, image models render text badly. Never describe a recognisable real person or a competitor brand.

PRODUCT: " + ($json.product.name || "") + "
WHAT IT IS: " + ($json.product.description || "") + "
CATEGORY: " + ($json.product.category || "") + "
KEY FEATURES: " + ($json.product.key_features || "") + "

CREATIVE BRIEFS TO ILLUSTRATE:
" + ($json.brief_lines || "") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. One key creatives holding an array with one entry per brief above, in the same order. Each entry has keys: label, prompt, caption.
label must be copied exactly from the brief label.
prompt is a single detailed image generation prompt, 40 to 70 words. Describe the subject, the setting, the lighting, the camera angle, the colour palette and the mood. Set it in a believable Indian home or workspace. End every prompt with the words: photorealistic product photography, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption is one short line the brand could use with this image on social.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.7,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}
